mcpServers.name: fetch
mcpServers.description: Fetch content from any URL — no configuration needed

zh.name: 网页抓取
zh.summary: 拉取任意网址的内容并转成可读文本，无需任何配置。
zh.whenToUse: 需要阅读某个网页或在线文档的内容时。

en.name: Web fetch
en.summary: Fetch any URL's content and convert it to readable text; zero configuration.
en.whenToUse: When you need to read a web page or an online document.

canonical.brief: Fetches a URL over plain HTTP GET and returns the body as readable text/markdown. Zero configuration. Prefer for reading public pages; not for authenticated or interactive sites.

mcpServers.name: time
mcpServers.description: Get current time and timezone information — no configuration needed

zh.name: 时间与时区
zh.summary: 查询当前时间、做时区换算与日期计算。
zh.whenToUse: 遇到「现在几点/换算时区/几天后是哪天」一类问题时。

en.name: Time & timezone
en.summary: Current time, timezone conversion, and date arithmetic.
en.whenToUse: For 'what time is it now', timezone conversion, or date math.

canonical.brief: Returns current time in a requested IANA timezone and converts/computes dates. Deterministic; no network.

mcpServers.name: everything
mcpServers.description: Demo MCP server for testing — no configuration needed
mcpServers.installInstructions: No additional configuration needed. This is a demo/test server.

zh.name: 测试服务器（Everything）
zh.summary: 官方演示服务器：回显、采样等测试能力，用于验证 MCP 链路本身。
zh.whenToUse: 调试或验证 MCP 连接是否通时。

en.name: Everything (test server)
en.summary: The official demo server: echo/sampling test utilities for verifying the MCP path itself.
en.whenToUse: When debugging or verifying an MCP connection.

canonical.brief: Reference test server exercising echo, sampling, and resource primitives. Not for production tasks; useful to prove the transport works.

mcpServers.name: sequential-thinking
mcpServers.description: Break down complex problems into step-by-step thinking processes

zh.name: 逐步思考
zh.summary: 提供结构化的分步思考草稿区，把复杂问题拆成小步推进。
zh.whenToUse: 复杂推理或规划任务需要中途草稿时。

en.name: Sequential thinking
en.summary: A structured scratchpad for step-by-step reasoning on complex problems.
en.whenToUse: When a complex plan benefits from explicit intermediate steps.

canonical.brief: Maintains a revision-friendly chain-of-thought scratchpad: record a thought, revise or branch it. Purely organizational; emits no side effects.

mcpServers.name: memory
mcpServers.description: Persistent memory system for storing and retrieving information across conversations

zh.name: 长期记忆
zh.summary: 本地知识图谱式记忆库：存取实体、关系与事实备忘。
zh.whenToUse: 需要跨会话记住事实或关系时。

en.name: Memory
en.summary: A local knowledge-graph memory: store and recall entities, relations, and facts.
en.whenToUse: When facts must persist across sessions.

canonical.brief: Stores entities/relations/observations in a local JSON knowledge graph under the memory dir. Scope is local to this machine.

mcpServers.name: puppeteer
mcpServers.description: Browser automation - navigate, screenshot, and interact with web pages
mcpServers.installInstructions: No additional configuration needed. Puppeteer will download Chromium automatically.

zh.name: 浏览器自动化
zh.summary: 驱动无头浏览器打开网页、点击与截图。
zh.whenToUse: 需要看渲染后的页面、截图或做网页操作时。

en.name: Browser automation
en.summary: Drive a headless browser: navigate, click, and screenshot.
en.whenToUse: When you need the rendered page or to interact with a site.

canonical.brief: Drives headless Chromium: navigate/click/fill/screenshot. Use for JS-rendered pages; slower than fetch and can hit site bot-walls.

mcpServers.name: filesystem
mcpServers.description: Read, write, and manage files and directories on your local system
mcpServers.installInstructions: Replace '/path/to/allowed/directory' with the directory you want to grant access to

zh.name: 本地文件
zh.summary: 在授权目录内读写、搜索本地文件。
zh.whenToUse: 需要整理、查找或改写本机文件时。

en.name: Local files
en.summary: Read, write, and search files inside the authorized directories.
en.whenToUse: When organizing, finding, or editing local files.

canonical.brief: File CRUD and search restricted to the allowed-roots configured at startup. Paths outside the roots are rejected.

zh.name: 读文件
zh.summary: 读取一个文本文件的内容。

canonical.brief: Reads a UTF-8 text file inside the allowed roots.

zh.name: 写文件
zh.summary: 把内容写入一个文件（整文件覆盖）。

en.name: Write file
en.summary: Write content to a file (full overwrite).

canonical.brief: Creates or fully overwrites a file inside the allowed roots.

zh.name: 列目录
zh.summary: 列出一个目录下的条目。

canonical.brief: Lists direct children of a directory inside the allowed roots.

mcpServers.name: sqlite
mcpServers.installInstructions: Replace '/path/to/database.db' with the path to your SQLite database file

zh.name: SQLite 数据库
zh.summary: 对本地 SQLite 库执行查询与更新。
zh.whenToUse: 需要查或改本地结构化数据时。

en.name: SQLite database
en.summary: Run queries and updates on a local SQLite database.
en.whenToUse: When local structured data needs querying or updating.

canonical.brief: Executes SQL against the configured SQLite file. Schema changes are possible — confirm destructive DDL with the user first.

mcpServers.name: github
mcpServers.description: Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and more
mcpServers.installInstructions: Create a GitHub personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens and replace 'your_token_here'

zh.name: GitHub
zh.summary: 操作 GitHub：仓库/issue/PR 的查询与创建。
zh.whenToUse: 需要查仓库状态、建 issue、开 PR 时。

en.name: GitHub
en.summary: Work with GitHub: query and create repos, issues, and pull requests.
en.whenToUse: When checking repo state, filing issues, or opening PRs.

canonical.brief: GitHub API operations (repos/issues/PRs/files). Honors the configured token's scopes; read calls are safe, write calls create real GitHub content.

zh.name: 建 issue
zh.summary: 在指定仓库新建一个 issue。

en.name: Create issue
en.summary: Open a new issue on a repository.

canonical.brief: Creates a real GitHub issue with title/body on the given repo.

zh.name: 列 issue
zh.summary: 按条件列出仓库的 issue。

en.name: List issues
en.summary: List a repository's issues with filters.

canonical.brief: Lists issues (state/labels/filters) for a repo; read-only.

zh.name: 建 PR
zh.summary: 从分支向目标分支发起 pull request。

en.name: Create PR
en.summary: Open a pull request from a branch.

canonical.brief: Opens a real pull request; requires an existing branch with the changes.

mcpServers.name: postgres
mcpServers.installInstructions: Replace the connection string with your PostgreSQL database credentials

zh.name: PostgreSQL
zh.summary: 对 PostgreSQL 数据库做受控查询。
zh.whenToUse: 需要查库中数据或做受控写操作时。

en.name: PostgreSQL
en.summary: Run controlled queries against a PostgreSQL database.
en.whenToUse: When data in the database needs querying or controlled writes.

canonical.brief: Executes SQL against the configured PostgreSQL instance via the connection string. Treat every write as production-affecting.
